column1: tedious§The work is tedious rather than difficult, and the four people who do it have never been thanked.§这项工作是**枯燥乏味的**而非困难的，做它的四个人从未被感谢过。§taed（厌烦）
temerity§He had the temerity to correct the chair's arithmetic and turned out, on checking, to be right.§他竟有这种**冒失**去纠正主席的算术，一核对，他是对的。§temer（轻率）
temperamental§The machine is temperamental below four degrees and flawless for the other nine months.§这台机器在四度以下**性情不定**，其余九个月完美无缺。§temper（性情，同 temperament 气质）
temperance§Temperance in argument served her better over four years than nine years of simply being right had.§四年间，论辩中的**克制**给她带来的好处，超过九年单靠正确所带来的。§temper（调和，同 temperate 温和的）
temporal§The temporal gap is the problem: the cause is in March and the effect appears in September.§**时间上的**间隔才是问题——原因在三月，结果九月才出现。§tempor（时间，同 temporary 临时的）
temporarily§The road was closed temporarily in 1994 and has not reopened in the four decades since.§这条路在 1994 年**临时**封闭，此后四十年再未开放。§
temporize§He temporized for nine months, and by the time he decided both options had expired.§他**拖延观望**了九个月，等他决定时两个选项都过了期。§tempor（时间）→ 拿时间做文章
tempt§Nothing tempted her back into administration, though four institutions tried over about nine years.§没有什么能**诱使**她重回行政岗位，尽管四家机构在约九年里试过。§
tenable§The position is no longer tenable, and the four people defending it stopped believing it years ago.§这个立场已**站不住脚**，为它辩护的四个人多年前就不再相信它了。§ten（拿住，同 contain 容纳）→ 守得住
tenacious§Her tenacious pursuit of one footnote uncovered a forgery that had stood for ninety years.§她对一条脚注**执着的**追查，揭出了一桩立了九十年的伪造。§ten（拿住，同 tenant 租户）→ 抓住不放
tenacity§The tenacity required is the real qualification: four years of refusals before the first yes.§真正的资格是所需的**韧性**——第一次点头前有四年的拒绝。§
tenet§The central tenet of the school is that nothing counts until it has been measured twice.§这个学派的核心**信条**是：任何东西在被测量两次之前都不算数。§ten（拿住）→ 秉持不放的主张
tension§The tension between the two aims is real, and nine years of policy has pretended otherwise.§这两个目标之间的**张力**是真实的，而九年的政策一直假装不然。§tens（伸展，同 extend 延伸）
tentative§The tentative conclusion was reported as certain, and four years of work went into confirming it.§这个**初步的**结论被当作确定的报道出去，随后四年的工作用于证实它。§tent（尝试，同 attempt 尝试）
tenuous§The link is tenuous and the headline is not, which is a gap four editors let through.§这种关联很**脆弱**而标题不然，这个落差被四位编辑放了过去。§tenu（薄，同 attenuate 变细）
terminate§They terminated the contract in month nine and paid, in the end, for all forty-eight.§他们在第九个月**终止**了合同，最终却付了全部四十八个月的钱。§termin（界限，同 terminal 终端）
terse§His terse reply—four words—said more than the nine hundred that the department later issued.§他**简短**的回复只有四个词，说的却比部门后来发出的九百字还多。§ters（擦净）→ 擦得没有多余
testify§Four witnesses testified to the same nine minutes and described four different sequences of events.§四位证人就同样的九分钟**作证**，描述出四种不同的事件顺序。§test（证据，同 testimony 证词）
texture§The texture of the paper dates it to within about four years, which settled the whole dispute.§纸张的**质地**把年代定到约四年之内，这解决了整场争议。§text（编织，同 textile 纺织品）
theorist§The theorist who predicted it in 1968 was ignored by four generations of experimentalists.§1968 年预言此事的**理论家**被四代实验物理学家无视。§
therapeutic§The therapeutic effect appears in about nine weeks, and most patients stop taking it after four.§**治疗**效果约九周后出现，而多数病人四周后就停药了。§
thoughtless§The thoughtless sentence was written in four seconds and repeated for the next nine years.§这句**欠考虑的**话是四秒钟写出来的，此后被重复了九年。§
threaten§Four departments threatened to withdraw, and the change was made within a week of the fourth.§四个部门**威胁**退出，在第四个提出后一周内改动就做了。§
thrive§The species thrives on disturbed ground, which is why it is commonest along the newest four roads.§这个物种在被扰动的地面上**繁盛**，所以它在最新的四条路边最常见。§
thunderous§The thunderous applause lasted four minutes and was, according to nine witnesses, entirely spontaneous.§这阵**雷鸣般的**掌声持续四分钟，据九位在场者说完全是自发的。§thunder（雷）
thwart§One committee member thwarted a proposal that the other nine had spent four months preparing.§一名委员**挫败**了另外九人筹备四个月的提案。§
timeless§The design is timeless in the useful sense: it has needed no modification in ninety years.§这个设计在有用的意义上是**经得起时间的**——九十年不需改动。§
timely§The warning was timely and ignored, and the collapse came four days after it was filed.§这次警告**及时**却被无视，坍塌在它归档四天后发生。§
timeworn§The timeworn argument is trotted out every four years and has never once persuaded anyone.§这套**陈旧的**说辞每四年被搬出来一次，从未说服过任何人。§time（时间）+ worn（磨损）
timid§The timid draft was rejected and the bold one, written in four hours, was adopted unanimously.§那份**畏首畏尾的**草案被否决，而四小时写成的大胆版本获一致通过。§tim（害怕）
timorous§She was timorous in meetings and devastating in writing, which four managers never worked out.§她在会上**胆怯**，落笔却极具杀伤力，四任经理都没弄明白这一点。§tim（害怕，同 timid 胆小的）
titer§The titer fell by half in nine weeks, and four of the eleven donors showed no response at all.§**滴度**在九周内下降一半，十一位供者中有四位完全没有反应。§
toady§The toady in the department was promoted twice and left, four years later, with nothing to show.§系里那个**溜须拍马的人**升了两次职，四年后一无所获地离开。§toad（蟾蜍）→ 江湖艺人的吞蟾助手
tolerable§The noise is perfectly tolerable for an hour and, over a nine-hour shift, measurably damaging to hearing.§这种噪音一小时完全**可以忍受**，而在九小时的班次里则对听力有可测的伤害。§toler（忍受，同 tolerate 容忍）
tolerate§The institution tolerated the behaviour for nine years and then, in four days, did not.§这家机构**容忍**了这种行为九年，然后在四天里不再容忍。§
tonic§The change of scene was a tonic, and she wrote four chapters in the first nine days.§换个环境是一剂**提神良药**，她在头九天写了四章。§ton（张力，同 tone 音调）→ 让身体绷起来
totalitarian§The totalitarian state kept excellent records, which is why historians can name nine thousand of its victims.§这个**极权**国家记录极佳，所以史学家能说出它九千名受害者的名字。§total（全部）
totality§The totality of the evidence points one way, and four individual pieces point the other.§证据的**整体**指向一个方向，而其中四项单独看指向另一个。§
tout§Agents tout the flats as riverside, and the river is four hundred metres away behind a road.§中介**吹嘘**这些公寓临河，而河在四百米外、一条马路后面。§
toxic§The compound is toxic at doses nine times lower than the ones anyone had thought to test.§这种化合物在比任何人想到要测试的剂量低九倍时就**有毒**。§toxic（毒）
toxicity§Toxicity was assessed in four studies, and none of them ran longer than ninety days.§**毒性**在四项研究中被评估，而没有一项超过九十天。§
tractable§The problem became tractable once someone reframed it as four small questions instead of one large one.§一旦有人把它重构成四个小问题而非一个大问题，这个难题就变得**好处理**了。§tract（拉，同 tractor 拖拉机）→ 拉得动
trait§The trait appears in about one bird in nine and is invisible until the wing is opened.§这个**特征**约每九只鸟出现一次，翅膀不张开就看不见。§tract（拉）→ 描出来的一笔
traitor§The traitor of one account is the patriot of another, and both were written by people who were there.§一份记述里的**叛徒**是另一份里的爱国者，而两份都出自在场者之手。§trad（交出，同 tradition 传统）→ 把自己人交出去
tranquil§The bay is tranquil for nine months and, in the four winter storms, genuinely dangerous.§这个海湾九个月**宁静**，而在四场冬季风暴中确实危险。§tranquill（平静）
tranquillise§Nothing tranquillised the market until the central bank said, in four words, what it would do.§直到央行用四个词说明它会怎么做，市场才**平静**下来。§
transcribe§She transcribed nine hours of interviews by hand and found four contradictions no recording would show.§她手工**誊录**了九小时访谈，发现四处任何录音都显不出的矛盾。§trans（跨过）+ scrib（写，同 describe 描述）
transgression§The transgression was minor and the punishment was not, and four colleagues wrote to say so.§这次**越轨**是轻微的而处罚不是，四位同事去信这么说了。§trans（跨过）+ gress（走，同 progress 前进）
transient§The population is transient: about four in nine households move within two years of arriving.§这里的人口是**流动的**——约九户中有四户在到来两年内搬走。§trans（跨过）+ it（走，同 exit 出去）
transitory§The advantage was transitory, and by the fourth quarter three competitors had matched it.§这项优势是**短暂的**，到第四季度三个竞争对手都追平了。§
transmit§The disease transmits before symptoms appear, which is why four countries' screening failed entirely.§这种病在症状出现前就**传播**，所以四个国家的筛查完全失效。§trans（跨过）+ mit（送，同 mission 使命）
transparent§The process is transparent in name: nine documents are published and the four that matter are not.§这个流程名义上是**透明的**——九份文件被公布，而要紧的四份没有。§trans（穿过）+ par（显现，同 appear 出现）
travesty§The consultation was a travesty of the process the statute describes in nine detailed paragraphs.§这次咨询是对法条用九个详细段落所描述流程的**拙劣歪曲**。§trans（跨过）+ vest（穿衣，同 vest 背心）→ 换装乔扮
treacly§The treacly ending was added after four test screenings, and the original is on the director's cut.§这个**甜得发腻的**结尾是四次试映后加的，原版收在导演剪辑里。§treacle（糖蜜）
treatise§The treatise runs to nine hundred pages and its argument fits, comfortably, on four.§这部**论著**长达九百页，而它的论点四页就能从容装下。§tract（处理，同 treat 对待）
tremulous§Her tremulous first four minutes gave way to the clearest testimony the court heard all week.§她**颤抖的**头四分钟之后，是法庭那一周听到的最清晰的证词。§trem（颤抖，同 tremor 震颤）
trenchant§The most trenchant criticism came from someone who had spent nine years defending the same policy.§最**尖锐犀利的**批评来自一个曾用九年为同一政策辩护的人。§
tribulation§Nine years of tribulation ended with a four-line letter that nobody had expected to arrive.§九年的**磨难**以一封无人预期会到来的四行信告终。§tribul（碾谷）→ 被反复碾压
tribute§The tribute was paid in silence by four hundred people who had never met the man.§四百个从未见过这个人的人以沉默致以**敬意**。§tribut（缴纳，同 contribute 贡献）
trigger§One email triggered a review that took nine months and changed four departments' procedures.§一封邮件**触发**了一场历时九个月、改变四个部门流程的评审。§
triumph§The triumph lasted about four days, and the invoice for it arrived in the ninth week.§这份**胜利**持续约四天，而它的账单在第九周寄到。§triumph（凯旋）
trivial§The change looked trivial and moved about four hundred thousand pounds between two budgets.§这处改动看着**微不足道**，却在两个预算之间挪动了约四十万英镑。§tri（三）+ vi（路，同 via 经由）→ 三岔路口人人可闻的琐事
trivialize§The summary trivializes a finding that four separate teams took nine years to establish.§这份摘要**轻描淡写**了一项四支独立团队花九年才确立的发现。§
tropical§The tropical species has survived four winters here, which nobody in 1994 thought possible.§这种**热带**物种在这里挺过四个冬天，1994 年没人认为这可能。§tropic（回归线）
troubadour§The troubadour's four surviving songs are the only evidence that the language was ever sung.§这位**行吟诗人**留存的四首歌，是这种语言曾被歌唱过的唯一证据。§古普罗旺斯语 trobar（创作）
trove§The trove included nine hundred letters, four diaries, and a shopping list from 1911.§这批**珍藏**包括九百封信、四本日记，还有一张 1911 年的购物清单。§
truce§The truce held for four days, which was three days longer than either side had expected.§**休战**维持了四天，比双方预期的都多三天。§true（忠信）→ 立约守信
